titre: Control Test n°1 — English (5th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Reading - Comprehension
Read the text then answer the questions.

Hello! My name is Sonia. I am ten years old. I am in the fifth year. This is my school. It is big and clean. My classroom is on the first floor. I have many friends. My favourite subject is English. I like my teacher. She is very kind.

Questions:
1) What is her name? (1 pt)
2) How old is she? (1 pt)
3) Where is her classroom? (0.5 pt)
4) What is her favourite subject? (0.5 pt)
5) True or False: Her school is small. (0.5 pt)
6) True or False: Her teacher is kind. (0.5 pt)

Vocabulary - Match
Match each object with the right room:
a) bed
b) sofa
c) cooker
d) car
( kitchen / garage / bedroom / living room )

Complete
Complete with words from the box: ( school - book - pencil - bag )
a) I read a ....... .
b) I write with a ....... .
c) I put my things in my ....... .
d) I learn at ....... .

Grammar - a / an
Complete with a or an:
a) ....... apple
b) ....... book
c) ....... orange

Writing
Write 2 or 3 sentences about your school (its name, big or small, your favourite subject).

Grammar: plural nouns (+ s).
Write the plural.
1) a book -> two ..........
2) a bag -> three ..........
3) a pencil -> four ..........
